title: JIRA Integration Fails in Claude Code with Authentication Error
body:
**Bug Description**
 Cannot use new JIRA integration. The integration works fine in Claude Desktop, but I can't add it to Claude Code. When I use `claude mcp add-from-claude-desktop`, the Atlassian MCP is not included in 
the list of options. When I do `claude mcp add atlassian https://mcp.atlassian.com/v1/sse`, the command succeeds and the MCP is added, but when I load claude code with `claude --debug --verbose  --mcp-debug` I get "MCP server "atlassian" Connection failed: spawn https://mcp.atlassian.com/v1/sse ENOENT". It appears Claude Code is unable to authenticate with the Atlessian remote MCP.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: macos
- Terminal: intellij
- Version: 0.2.113
- Feedback ID: fb336173-c162-471e-819b-cc1291d3f81a

**Errors**
